report_title: Telemetry Leakage Incident Response & Containment Report

containment_steps.description: Automated telemetry stream scanner identifies anomalous pattern matching unmasked token
P1 Security Alert dispatched to Security Operations Center (SOC) on-call channel
Temporary block placed on query API for affected partition index to prevent read exposure
Cryptographically verified redaction and index purge executed on offending log record
Automated pull-request rule update and pipeline sanitizer regression test generated
